selected_engineering_route.name: role-aware premium cel-painted webcomic with clear-line causal staging and variable narrative cadence
selected_engineering_route.finish: Use mature cel-painted faces, graphic shadow/value separation, restrained painterly color, and clear-line contour hierarchy within one chapter palette; allow measured density variation by beat.
selected_engineering_route.composition: Treat the exact ComicPanelPlan safe zone, panel role, width, alignment, and post-panel gutter as compiler inputs. Stage causal action and role order before finish detail.
selected_engineering_route.continuity: Use P050/P040 identity evidence plus explicit light-brown-haired Soren, dark-tied-haired Sigrid, oatmeal coat, and plaid wrap assertions. P036 remains composition-only.
selected_engineering_route.causal_language: Describe the smallest physical chain from hands through one object to target. P036 is one straight reach-and-brace plank, not a lever.
chapter_cadence: wide 1040px-class action, orientation, and reveal anchors
medium 700-780px dialogue, deduction, continuity, and sensory beats
tall 700-760px causal panels showing the complete hand-object-target chain
left/center/right staggering and larger gutters at sequence turns

lettering.rule: No balloon or direct text may obscure faces, people, important hands, or story objects; transparency is conditional on preserved expression, silhouette, action, contrast, and phone readability.
lettering.measurement_boundary: Safe-zone luma and edge statistics are exploratory only and cannot approve lettering.

production_status: strongest measured engineering recommendation; owner review, commercial clearance, deterministic generation reproducibility, and exact-base acceptance remain pending
next_experiment: Run a deterministic transparent-lettering rehearsal on c005/c014 plus clean controls, then compile the smallest reproducible chapter-production manifest.
